dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Hmmm... Where are the latest journals? Come on now...

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Gah! Quiet, quiet! I'm looking for the latest research materials on mechanical devices...

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: I'm leaving as soon as I finish the latest mechanical research at the Fontaine Research Institute. Don't tell the boss. He's always giving me the stink eye for not buying...

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Ones about research into mechanical devices and the like, of course... Hehe. They even published the reader's letter I wrote to them last time...

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Ah, if only I had enough Mora... I'd be able to buy that issue.

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: But there are always more important things to spend Mora on... aren't there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, you take your time looking.

dialogues.speaker: Brovinov
dialogues.text: Oh, I will... Also, shhh. Keep it down, please...
